name: IDE Integration
steps: Create test stubs for IDE integration
acceptance_criteria: VS Code extension stub with package.json
LSP server stub with basic protocol support

findings.vscode_extension: Complete stub with package.json, extension.js, README, and CHANGELOG. Includes commands for generating context, status bar integration, and template selection.
findings.jetbrains_plugin: Complete stub with plugin.xml, Java action classes, and README. Defines actions for IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs.
findings.lsp_server: Stub implementation with token estimation. Can work without vscode-languageserver package (runs in stub mode).
findings.tests: 15 tests covering all components. All tests pass with full test suite (1121 total tests).
